handoffCopy.createPageHint: First evaluation lab (Acme warm-up): paste the constrained support prompt below, add one Plan Basic price question, then run full automation. Your evaluation will be highlighted on the dashboard when automation finishes.
handoffCopy.dashboardBanner: Your First evaluation lab run is highlighted. Open Compare, then return to the lab when you are done.

steps.title: Open create with the Acme warm-up
steps.body: Open AiEval create. Title the evaluation "Acme support warm-up". Paste this constrained prompt: You are Acme support. Answer using only the provided policy context. Use short plain sentences. If the policy is silent, say you do not have that information. Never invent prices, windows or coverage. Add context note: Plan Basic costs $9 per month.

steps.title: Add one golden question
steps.body: Use the question: How much is Plan Basic per month? Keep sampling settings default so this warm-up stays simple. You will expand the deck in the decision lab.

steps.title: Run full automation
steps.body: Click Run full automation so AiEval generates answers, scores them and stores the run. This may take a few minutes depending on providers. The Learn highlight appears after automation finishes.

steps.title: Find the run on the dashboard
steps.body: Open the dashboard. Your lab evaluation is highlighted so you can spot it among other evaluations.

steps.title: Skim Compare once
steps.body: Open Compare from the Learn banner (or the highlighted card) and note which answer looks more faithful on the price question. This warm-up proves the harness loop. The next lab asks for a full ship decision.
